author: ruixen.ui
name: modern-payment-form
description: This modern Payment Modal UI component presents a sleek and user-friendly design for selecting payment options. With clear buttons for different payment methods like PayPal, users can quickly initiate their preferred transaction flow. The modal includes styled input fields for billing and card details, enhancing readability and usability. The layout is visually structured to guide users through the payment process step-by-step, offering both form validation and interactive feedback cues.
